notes.general_comments:
There were 153 candidates with a mean score of 16.4. This paper contained a number of challenging
questions and candidates did well to achieve a mean percentage score of 54.6%. Four of the questions, 2,
12, 14 and 30 turned out to be relatively easy i.e. more then 80% of the candidates chose the correct
answer. At the other extreme, there were three questions, 4, 21 and 29, which had facility scores below the
25 % guessing level.
